tools.name: request_mrv_report
tools.description: Verify a carbon project's MRV claim via Sentinel-2 and MWCM-Oh. Returns signed Ed25519 attestation with Lean 4 proof hash. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, ISO 14064-3. Not a carbon credit certificate. Cost £150 per call.

tools.name: request_mrv_report_lite
tools.description: Verify a carbon project's basic NDVI via Sentinel-2. Returns signed Ed25519 NDVI attestation. No Lean 4 proof. Not a carbon credit. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, ISO 14064-3 lite. Cost £5 per call.

tools.name: verify_biodiversity
tools.description: Verify a biodiversity claim for a geographic habitat. Returns signed Ed25519 attestation with Lean 4 NDVI proof vs claimed_score_min. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, TNFD. Not a tradable credit. Cost £150 per call.

tools.name: verify_skip_twin
tools.description: Verify a circular-economy Skip Passport against the waste-diversion twin. Returns JSON passport with Lean 4 proof hash. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14. Cost £10 per call.

tools.name: verify_site_certification
tools.description: Verify city planning constraints for a development site. Returns signed Ed25519 attestation and 30-year compliance trail. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, ISO 14064-3. Cost £3,000–£5,000 per call.

tools.name: verify_agent_trust
tools.description: Verify an AI agent's identity (KYA-OS DID) and behavioral trust score. Returns a signed Ed25519 TrustVerification envelope with fail-closed attestation. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, KYA-OS. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: verify_transaction_evidence
tools.description: Verify a completed M2M transaction evidence pack, Lean 4 hash, and settlement. Returns signed JSON with provenance. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, KYA-OS. Cost $0.05 per call.

tools.name: issue_agent_attestation
tools.description: Issue a signed trust attestation for an agent DID and optional capabilities. Returns Ed25519 attestation envelope. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, KYA-OS, IETF AID. Cost $0.50 per call.

tools.name: run_geo_audit
tools.description: Verify generative-engine optimization for a merchant URL (schema.org, feed, agent-card). Returns JSON GEO score with gaps. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 50, schema.org. Cost £99 per call.

tools.name: get_agent_visibility
tools.description: Retrieve estimated LLM mention rate and GEO score for a merchant URL. Returns JSON visibility metrics. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 50, schema.org. Cost £0.01 per call.

tools.name: verify_agent_attestation
tools.description: Verify an agent's IATP codebase/config attestation (Ed25519, fail-closed). Returns JSON validity result. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, KYA-OS, IETF AID. Cost $0.02 per call.

tools.name: verify_agent_reputation
tools.description: Retrieve an agent's IATP reputation trust score (0-10) after FACT slashing. Returns JSON score and trust level. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, KYA-OS, IETF AID. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: run_abv_assessment
tools.description: Verify pre-deployment agent behavior against a Worker Remit. Returns JSON maturity (0-100), gaps, and recommendations. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, KYA-OS. Cost $0.50 per call.

tools.name: get_agent_maturity
tools.description: Retrieve the stored ABV maturity score (0-100) for an agent. Returns JSON score. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, KYA-OS. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: get_tevv_alignment
tools.description: Retrieve NIST AI 200-2 TEVV-Athlon mapping for IATP, ABV, FACT, and Lean 4. Returns JSON alignment document. Compliance: NIST AI 200-2, EU AI Act Art. 9, 13, 15. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: generate_tevv_report
tools.description: Issue a TEVV-Athlon assessment report from stored IATP reputation and ABV maturity. Returns JSON alignment scores. Compliance: NIST AI 200-2, EU AI Act Art. 9, 13, 15. Cost $0.50 per call.

tools.name: memory.write
tools.description: Store a client-encrypted memory entry for an entity. Server never sees plaintext (PBKDF2/AES-256-GCM). Requires wallet signature. Returns JSON receipt. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.read
tools.description: Retrieve client-encrypted memory entries for an entity. Returns ciphertext, nonce, and content_hash - never plaintext. Requires wallet signature. Compliance: GDPR Art. 15, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.grant
tools.description: Grant another wallet time-bounded access to specified memory entries. Returns grant receipt; immutable consent row written. Compliance: GDPR Art. 7, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.revoke
tools.description: Revoke a previously issued memory grant immediately. Returns JSON revocation receipt. Compliance: GDPR Art. 7, 17. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.tool_context
tools.description: Retrieve non-sensitive metadata on prior tool invocations for an entity (count, timestamps, last hash). Never returns ciphertext. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5, 15. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.pricing_hint
tools.description: Retrieve a signed, non-binding recommendation of verification-call cost from memory. Returns JSON hint; 402 list price unchanged. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.subscription_quote
tools.description: Retrieve a signed, non-binding monthly subscription quote for a wallet. Returns JSON quote; x402 prepaid funding. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5, 7. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.attest
tools.description: Issue an Ed25519-signed portable attestation for a memory entry. Returns envelope for offline verify; server does not store it. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.verify_attestation
tools.description: Verify a memory attestation envelope against the platform key registry. Returns JSON validity result; also verifiable offline. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

tools.name: memory.query
tools.description: Query owner memory entries by entity_type, category, tags, or time range. Returns ciphertext plus metadata - never plaintext. Requires wallet signature. Compliance: GDPR Art. 15, 20. Cost $0.01 per call.
